references.text: Moses inspected the work and saw that the Israelites had done everything just as the Lord had commanded. This shows the same obedience to the Lord's commands through Moses.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him. The same theme of complete obedience to God's commands given through Moses.
Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything the Lord had commanded Moses. A parallel to the obedience of Aaron and his sons.
A command to keep the Lord's commands without adding anything or taking anything away. Emphasizes the importance of doing everything the Lord commands.
Everything the Lord commands must be kept carefully, without addition or subtraction. The same principle of complete obedience.
Moses was faithful in all God's house as a servant. The obedience of Aaron and his sons reflects this faithfulness to God's commands through Moses.
